mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deteriorating consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 55% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 100), declining industrial production signals economic slowdown, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and declining fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 55% of cases, or effect size < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth fails to correlate with positive 60d returns (Rank IC < 0.05) over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative 5d returns in > 55% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In housing recovery regimes (HOUST > 900), rising housing starts signal improving consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 900 fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases.
